# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and cache corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.2 will correct texture sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering. The upcoming servicing update also aligns image-filter cache-key equality with hashing, without changing the public managed or C API.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Keep filtered images within texture subsets** — Corrects sampling constraints for antialiased and multisampled Ganesh draws under minification or strong skew. Logical texture bounds and stricter subset clamping prevent unrelated backing-texture pixels from contaminating filtered images. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Consistent image-filter caching** — Makes image-filter cache-key equality match its bytewise hash, distinguishing signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata for consistent lookup and eviction. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Correct mask-filtered glyph handling** — Handles font-scaler reloads that change glyph paths, formats, or bounds. Uses the reloaded outline, rejects incompatible overlap copies, and preserves full plane strides for clipped emboss masks, avoiding stale rendering, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted mask planes. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
